Package Application

Class DuckTest

java.lang.Object
Application.DuckTest
public class DuckTest extends Object
JUnit test class for the Duck class. This class verifies that the Duck's attributes and behaviors (such as setting values, clamping limits, and toggling states) are working as expected.

  • Method Details

    • setUp

      public void setUp()
      Setup method that runs before each test. It creates a new Duck instance with the name "TestDuck" to ensure tests are run on a fresh object.

    • testInitialValues

      public void testInitialValues()
      Tests the initial default values of the Duck instance. Verifies that the duck's name, health, hunger, happiness, tiredness, score, coins, day counter, dead status, and colour are all initialized correctly.

    • testSetHunger

      public void testSetHunger()
      Tests the setHunger method. Checks that hunger decreases or increases correctly and is clamped within the 0-10 range.

    • testSetHappiness

      public void testSetHappiness()
      Tests the setHappiness method. Ensures that happiness adjusts correctly and is clamped between 0 and 100.

    • testSetTiredness

      public void testSetTiredness()
      Tests the setTiredness method. Verifies that tiredness is increased or decreased correctly and remains within the 0-100 boundaries.

    • testSetHealthAndFlipLivingState

      public void testSetHealthAndFlipLivingState()
      Tests the setHealth method and the automatic flip of the living state. Decreases health and ensures that when health falls below zero, the duck is marked as dead and health is reset to 0.

    • testScoreCoinsAndDay

      public void testScoreCoinsAndDay()
      Tests the adjustments for score, coins, and day counter. Verifies that scores do not drop below 0, coin counts adjust correctly, and the day counter increments.

    • testSetAndGetColour

      public void testSetAndGetColour()
      Tests the setColour and getColour methods. Verifies that the duck's colour is updated correctly.

    • testIsAngry

      public void testIsAngry()
      Tests the isAngry method. A duck is considered angry if its happiness is below 25. This test decreases happiness to trigger anger and then increases it to revert the angry state.

    • testFlipLivingState

      public void testFlipLivingState()
      Tests the flipLivingState method. Verifies that flipping the living state toggles the duck's dead status without altering the health when health is non-zero.
